name: Mitsubishi Research Institute, Inc.
summary: Mitsubishi Research Institute, Inc. provides research, consulting, and ICT solutions to the public and private sectors in Japan. It offers consulting services for management, digital transformation, energy, sustainability, food and agriculture, information and communication technology, regions, communities, mobility, healthcare, human resources, disaster prevention and risk management, and global strategy. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
